args.title: firecrawl_scrape tool not registered - unable to cache Oracle AI agent use cases URL
args.body: The agent has encountered persistent 'not_cached' errors for the URL 'https://www.oracle.com/artificial-intelligence/ai-agents/ai-agent-use-cases/'. Attempts to resolve by scraping the URL via firecrawl_scrape have failed with 'Tool \"v2_local_actions.firecrawl_scrape\" is not registered on any adapter.' This prevents caching the resource and blocks resource-driven operations.
